## About
The Cool Saguaro is a family-owned heating, air conditioning and plumbing contractor on W Adams St in Phoenix. We're licensed, bonded and insured, and we work on homes and businesses alike.
Whether it's fixing a leak, tuning up your AC or upgrading your whole system, our team will look at your needs and your equipment and give you an estimate before any work is booked. Then we'll find a day and time that works for you.
We serve Phoenix, Scottsdale, Mesa, Glendale, Gilbert and Chandler, and we hold a 5-star rating from 127 Google reviews.

## Services
- Tuning up your AC: Getting your air conditioning ready for the Phoenix heat, or upgrading your whole system when it's time.
- Maintenance, repair and installation: Upkeep, repairs and new installs for heating, cooling and plumbing.
- Plumbing repairs and installations: From leaks to burst pipes, we handle plumbing work for homes and businesses. One reviewer had a burst copper pipe at an outdoor spigot repaired.
- Water heaters: One reviewer had their water heater replaced by our team.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve Phoenix, Scottsdale, Mesa, Glendale, Gilbert and Chandler.

Q: Can I call after hours?
A: Yes. We're available around the clock in Phoenix and the surrounding areas.

Q: How does an estimate work?
A: Call us or use the form on our website. We'll assess your needs and your equipment, then give you an estimate before scheduling the work.

Q: Are you licensed?
A: Yes. We're licensed, bonded and insured, with ROC license numbers 342703 and 356538.

Q: Do you offer financing on a new AC unit?
A: One reviewer mentioned financing options when buying a new AC unit. Give us a call to ask what's available.
